label: <DEL> step of length-9 sequences (plus last copy steps on 2/o/u)
explanation: Fires essentially only in length-9 sequences (97% of mass; small amount at L=8, none for L<=7) and never in the original phase. About 75% of mass is at the <DEL> step (t=9) of L=9 sequences, where the top activations also sit; the rest is at the last one or two copy steps of L=9 sequences (t=16-17), mostly when the input there is 2, o or u. Only ~13% of L=9 <DEL> steps are active, though. Which ones fire depends weakly and diffusely on content (enriched when the first token is 3/o/h/2, i.e. the token being output; many digits help slightly), and no simple token rule picks them out. So precision is low (~0.12) while mass recall is high (~0.93).
